answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 20296 Country: India Title: can a muslim get marrige with a kafir for get her love? Question: can a muslim get marrige with a kafir for get her love? Answer ID: 20296 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 360/254/L=1431) Nikah of a Muslim with non-Muslim is not lawful. Almighty Allah says in the holy Quran: و لا تنكحوا المشركات حتى يومن الآية Wed not idolatresses till they believe. [1:221] However, if she accepts the truth of Islam and accepts Islam wholeheartedly, then a Muslim can marry her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
